q: By June 30, 2027, the IAEA or the government of a country involved announces that at least some of Iran's uranium enriched to 20 percent or more has been shipped out of Iran
basis: On October 20, 2026, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, said that not a single gram of enriched uranium would be shipped out of Iran. In 2015, the shipment took place on December 28, five months after the nuclear deal was signed on July 14. This forecast tests whether Washington's opening demand in its top-ranked course, shipment to a third country, can be met.
rs: Announcements by the IAEA and the U.S. and Iranian governments
